wikitext.*:
== General Information ==

* Author: Peter Vysparov
* Translator: Chaim Horowitz
* First Published: August 12, 2004

== Overview ==
Following Chaim Horowitz’s translation of the ancient text, the Book of Paths, Peter Vysparov embarked on an extensive effort to decipher the cryptic script. His journey was guided by Horowitz's hypothesis, suggesting a potential correlation between the text and the rites of Lemurian demonism outlined in his Pandemonium Matrix. Despite a few minor discrepancies, the hypothesis was found to be accurate. The concordance was reportedly completed in the early 1960s.

The Vysparov Library, custodians of the Book of Paths, made available a copy of the concordance for further studies and research.

== Rites and Paths ==
The concordance includes detailed analysis and mapping of several rites and paths.

=== Rites of Lurgo (1::0) ===

* Rt-1:[1890] = Pth-1. Original Subtraction

=== Rites of Duoddod (2::0) ===

* Rt-1:[271890] = Pth-2. Extreme Regression
* Rt-2:[27541890] = Pth-3. Abysmal Comprehension

=== Rites of Doogu (2::1) ===

* Rt-1:[1872] = Pth-4. Primordial Breath
* Rt-2:[271] = Pth-5. Slipping Backwards
* Rt-3:[27541] = Pth-6. Attaining Balance

=== Rites of Ixigool (3::1) ===

* Rt-1:[18723] = Pth-7. Progressive Levitation
* Rt-2:[1872563] = Pth-8. Eternal Digression

For the full list of Rites and Paths, please refer to the original document.

== Legacy ==
Vysparov’s Pandemonium Concordance for the Book of Paths is an important contribution to the understanding of the Lemurian demonism rites. The deep insights offered by the concordance have paved the way for a better understanding of the ancient text, the Book of Paths.
